changes.oldText: Recommended browser: Latest version of Chrome (at least > 80)
changes.oldHtml: Recommended browser: Latest version of Chrome (at least > 80)

changes.newText: Supported browsers: Chrome 123 or later, Edge 123 or later, Safari 17.5 or later, Firefox 125 or later
changes.newHtml: Supported browsers: Chrome 123 or later, Edge 123 or later, Safari 17.5 or later, Firefox 125 or later

changes.newText: When you open the WebUI in a browser older than the supported versions, the WebUI does not load. The loading screen shows a message that the browser is not supported, with the list of supported browsers. Update the browser or use one of the supported browsers.
changes.newHtml: When you open the WebUI in a browser older than the supported versions, the WebUI does not load. The loading screen shows a message that the browser is not supported, with the list of supported browsers. Update the browser or use one of the supported browsers.

changes.oldText: We do not support Microsoft Internet Explorer since it is deprecated and does not follow web standard, and does not support up-to-date browser features.
changes.newText: Microsoft Internet Explorer is not supported, because it is deprecated and does not support up-to-date browser features.
